text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the removal of an on-street accessible loading zone located on the west side of Margueretta Street, between a point 103 metres north of College Street and a point 5.5 metres further north.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing on-street accessible loading zone, operating at all times, on the west side of Margueretta Street, between a point 103 metres north of College Street and a point 5.5 metres further north.
